Frequently Asked Questions

Frequently Asked Questions

Short answers for property owners, PG owners, hostel owners, managers, and tenants evaluating Nestni.

What is Nestni?

Nestni is an owner and tenant management app that helps property owners manage tenants, rooms, rent, documents, and records in one place.

Who can use Nestni?

Nestni is useful for property owners, PG owners, hostel owners, flat owners, and property managers who manage tenants and rental properties.

Can I manage tenant documents in Nestni?

Yes. You can store and manage tenant documents safely inside the app, so you do not need to keep physical files or search through WhatsApp chats.

Can I add tenant emergency contact details?

Yes. You can save tenant emergency contact details for quick access when needed.

Can I track rent payments?

Yes. You can check who has paid rent, whose rent is pending, and view rent payment records easily.

Can I check vacant and occupied rooms?

Yes. Nestni helps you see which rooms are vacant and which rooms are occupied, so you can manage availability without confusion.
